speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Multiforme (likely secondary to Mycoplasma pneumoniae or a medication reaction). The recent hiking trip suggests potential exposure to an infectious trigger, while the new medication (captopril) is a potential drug-induced cause.
